changes_from_attempt_1: Worker action envelope decoding permits surrounding visible prose, matching text-plus-tool-call turns; raw responses remain retained. Summary decoding is unchanged and remains the production strict decoder.

Both conditions begin with the same authored handoff history backed by real fixture reads and actual initial failing tests. Setup is excluded from live-model behavior; every summary and subsequent continuation action is a real-model decision.
Each stage must complete its actual required effect before the next stage.
transport: authenticated Claude CLI, all built-in tools disabled, one inference turn per request; custom Unchain ModelIO executes fixture tools in the actual kernel
history_policy: Canonical full history is maintained independently. Each refresh summarizes the new omitted canonical prefix; recursive summary-of-summary is rejected by the implementation.
pressure_policy: Actual fixture tool results include explicitly labeled synthetic background logs, making each completed stage exceed the next-stage input budget.

acceptance.archive_integrity: Every archived message equals its canonical original; source digests and actual call/result links verify; every complete exchange has both sides.
acceptance.summary_grounding: Closed summary schema and valid source ids required; reviewer checks factual support, contradictions and unfinished items separately from mere reference existence.
acceptance.continuation: After each compressed stage, actual Unchain tools are used to advance the original task. Incident replay executes six elapsed-time boundary checks; coding uses five public tests plus a separate 100-case deterministic oracle. Final files and these independent checks are authoritative.
acceptance.retrieval: Final phase asks for a previously non-salient token from the earliest log. If absent from the view, the agent must retrieve it with the scoped archive tool.
acceptance.corrections: Stage-two correction supersedes the original instruction. Completion artifacts must use corrected values.
acceptance.unfinished: Tasks close only after successful fixture tool effects. Approval-denied publication remains blocked in final artifacts.
acceptance.pending: Adding an unmatched approval request under pressure must defer summary with zero model invocations. Adding the denial must allow continued compression.
acceptance.restart: After each compression reopen the directory store and repeat the same request; the archive/view must replay without another inference call.

limits: Single model, one repetition per condition: no broad reliability or cross-provider claim.
Controlled fixture tasks, not open-ended real-world repository qualification.
The inference transport is CLI-backed ModelIO, not native Anthropic SDK wire qualification.
A failed semantic cell remains failed; a later attempt never erases the first result.
No production source edits during this evaluation.
candidate_changes: Production decoder accepts one enclosing JSON fence, short exact model aliases map to canonical IDs, source/block provenance guards permission attribution, prompt distinguishes observed values from invented blockers, per-exchange chronological retrieval.
No external summary normalization; built-in AgentSummarizer is used directly. Prior candidate failures retained separately.
Raw canonical fixture tool results retained in both conditions via explicit high result budgets and disabled mid-run microcompact; this does not qualify default Agent composition.

Generic contrastive provenance example: future report timing and log relevance labels do not require approval or confirmation of already observed values; unsupported assistant prerequisites must not propagate. Candidate-1 task and archive checks passed but semantic confirmation drift is retained as failed evidence.
retrieval_probe: Separate bounded exact-original code/stderr/hash/call-ID recovery; same strict original-equality oracle as the failed baseline.
